# dungeonheroes

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Created with [`shinyphaser`](https://github.com/maciekbanas/shinyphaser).

This branch requires `shinyphaser` version
`r yaml::read_yaml("shinyphaser.yml")$required_version`. When the application is
loaded, it compares that exact version with the locally installed version and
warns if they differ.
